body: 🌟 The Multi-Agent Framework: First AI Software Company, Towards Natural Language Programming
plain_description: Turn a single sentence requirement into a complete software project. MetaGPT automates the entire software development lifecycle using AI agents that act as product managers, architects, and engineers. Get user stories, competitive analysis, data models, APIs, and production code from one prompt — reducing weeks of planning work to minutes.
technical_description: MetaGPT is a Python-based multi-agent orchestration framework that simulates a full software company using LLM agents. It decomposes a natural-language requirement into structured outputs — user stories, competitive analysis, requirements specs, data schemas, API definitions, and source code — by routing sub-tasks through specialized agent roles (product manager, architect, project manager, engineer) governed by configurable SOPs. The framework supports OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, and Groq as LLM backends, runs via CLI or as a Python library, and is installable via pip or Docker. Extensions include Data Interpreter for analytical coding, debate scenarios, and research agents.
title: MetaGPT
